pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark, polygonal regions with irregular, serrated edge boundaries. High angularity is present on the neck, transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries towards the lower flank and limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial space. Paths are of variable width, forming complex topological nodes at intersections, mostly three-point junctions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, high-frequency serrated contour along the dorsal neck, exhibiting a consistent vertical hair-stroke pattern against the background.
